implementation_contract.revalidation: Source evidence or bound Workspace movement never rewrites a historical capsule. implementation_contract.destination_snapshot: Destination assessment must remain bound to one coherent current WorkspaceObservation/runtime/capability environment. Concurrent environment or capability change fails closed and requires retry.
implementation_contract.capability_conflict: Contradictory current destination route availability is UNKNOWN/NEEDS_EVIDENCE, not optimistic AVAILABLE. Numeric editability/portability never prove semantic transfer.
implementation_contract.authority: All transfer/equivalence/render/freeze/recipe/version/mutation/provider/external authority fields remain false; this increment performs no DAW/provider call and adds no consumer execution surface.
